_doc: Frozen TSMOM-v1 parameters (docs/prereg/TSMOM-v1.md). Zero tunable parameters -- this is a literature-cited spec (Moskowitz, Ooi & Pedersen 2012), not a search. Changing anything here bumps strategy_version and requires a new pre-registration, not a walk-forward grid. Universe is the fixed 18-ETF list in strategy/tsmom_universe.cpp (kTsmomUniverse), not a point-in-time filter -- there is no universe.* block to mirror strategy.v1.json's.
